rich.3139cc57cb17.source:
Failure mode: stale embeddings.

A vector index is a cache of an embedding model's outputs. Production systems have to defend against a few specific failures:

  • Swap the embedding model and every cached vector becomes meaningless until you re-embed every passage.
  • The provider silently upgrades the model, and scores drift with no error raised.
  • Two services share an index but pin different model ids; the index returns nonsense to one of them.

A reliable index pins the embedding model id alongside each cached vector and refuses to mix versions. The canonical pin for this course is nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2, served through the course's hosted proxy at build.nvidia.com.
rich.3139cc57cb17.value:
故障模式：陳舊的嵌入。

向量索引是嵌入模型輸出的快取。生產系統必須防範以下幾種特定故障：

  • 一旦更換嵌入模型，所有快取向量都會失去意義，直到您重新嵌入每個段落。
  • 提供商悄悄升級模型，分數隨之漂移，卻不會觸發任何錯誤。
  • 兩個服務共享同一索引，卻固定使用不同的模型 ID；該索引會向其中一個服務傳回毫無意義的結果。

可靠的索引會為每個快取向量同時固定嵌入模型 ID，並拒絕混用不同版本。本課程的規範固定值是 nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2，透過課程託管在 build.nvidia.com 的代理提供服務。

rich.752b0fa26b3a.source:
Embedding API contract.

The embeddings endpoint takes a JSON request with three fields and returns one array of vectors:

  • input is the batch of texts to embed, typed string[].
  • model names the embedding model, typed string.
  • input_type is either "query" or "passage".
  • The response carries a data array whose entries each hold an embedding of number[].

The NVIDIA embed models assign the same text a different vector depending on the input_type you pass. The training objective pulls a question toward the passages that answer it rather than toward texts that merely repeat its words, so a cosine score between two correctly typed inputs tracks relevance well. Embedding a query with the "passage" type or the reverse breaks the score function silently and produces lower recall with no error message.
rich.752b0fa26b3a.value:
嵌入 API 契約。

嵌入 API 端點接收包含三個欄位的 JSON 請求，並傳回一個向量陣列：

  • input 是待嵌入的文字批次，型別為 string[]。
  • model 指定嵌入模型，型別為 string。
  • input_type 的值為 "query" 或 "passage"。
  • 回應包含一個 data 陣列，其中每個條目都包含型別為 embedding 的 number[]。

NVIDIA 嵌入模型會根據您傳入的 input_type，為同一文字生成不同的向量。訓練目標會讓問題更接近能夠回答它的段落，而不是僅僅重複其用詞的文字，因此，對兩個型別正確的輸入計算餘弦分數可以很好地反映相關性。如果使用 "passage" 型別嵌入查詢，或反過來使用錯誤型別，評分函式會悄無聲息地失效，召回率隨之降低，但不會顯示錯誤訊息。

rich.c4a5900e5e9b.source: The cost of the bolt-on. A retriever that never sees the generator's loss can only guess what the generator needs, so retrieval quality is capped by how well the embedding model fits your data. Reranking, query rewriting, and a fine-tuned embedder each buy back a little of what end-to-end training gave for free. A serious retrieval stack keeps adding stages to recover the rest. Read the bolt-on as a pragmatic stand-in for a once-unified system, and you can see where its ceiling sits and which knobs raise it.

text.0b5f8a075002.source: ReWOO (Reason Without Observation) is the alternative pattern. A planner LLM call writes the entire plan upfront as a list of tool calls. A deterministic executor then runs every tool, often in parallel. Finally a synthesizer LLM call reads all the gathered observations and writes the final answer. ReWOO trades adaptivity for parallelism: every tool call runs at once, but later steps cannot adjust based on earlier observations.
text.0b5f8a075002.value: ReWOO (Reason Without Observation) 是另一種模式。一次 planner LLM 呼叫會預先將完整規劃寫成工具呼叫列表。隨後，確定性執行器執行所有工具，通常會並行執行。最後，綜合器透過一次 LLM 呼叫讀取收集到的全部觀察結果並生成最終答案。ReWOO 以適應性換取並行能力：所有工具呼叫可以同時執行，但後續步驟無法根據先前的觀察結果進行調整。

text.96a4f1c854c2.source: ReAct (Reason+Act) is the classic agent loop. The model is given the user's task plus a set of tools. At each iteration the model emits either a tool call request or a final answer. When a tool call is requested, the host code executes the tool, appends the result as an observation, and the model continues. The loop terminates when finish_reason is 'stop' and there are no tool_calls. The pattern's strength is that each step adapts to the previous step's observation; its weakness is sequential cost: N steps means N model calls in order.
text.96a4f1c854c2.value: ReAct（Reason+Act）是經典的代理程式迴圈。模型會收到使用者任務和一組工具。在每次迭代中，模型會輸出工具呼叫請求或最終答案。如果模型請求呼叫工具，宿主程式碼就會執行該工具，將結果作為觀察追加到上下文中，然後由模型繼續處理。當 finish_reason 為“stop”且不存在 tool_calls 時，迴圈終止。這種模式的優勢在於，每一步都能根據上一步的觀察結果進行調整；劣勢則是順序執行成本：N 個步驟意味著必須依次呼叫模型 N 次。

text.ab36f417fde3.source: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) injects external knowledge into the model's context at inference time. A document corpus is embedded once and stored in a vector index. At query time the user's question is embedded and the top-K closest passages are retrieved. The retrieved passages are concatenated to the prompt and the model answers from that context. RAG sidesteps the model's training cutoff and lets you ground answers in private data without fine-tuning.
